en: Changed auto mode to ignore more allow rules that run any package, like `Bash(pnpm dlx *)`, and path or version forms of ones it already ignored (`/usr/bin/npm run:*`); the safety check decides those
zh: 变更 auto 模式以忽略更多运行任意包的允许规则，如 `Bash(pnpm dlx *)`，以及它已忽略规则的路径或版本形式（`/usr/bin/npm run:*`）；这些由安全检查决定
